memories_after: [Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Acceptance criteria for a reports/ or deliverables/ file may omit project-wide formatting conventions, so check project document rules in README.md and sibling files before submitting; because pre-merge checks in the docs project run only at merge time, do this before submitting a ticket that creates a document.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project enforces an automated pre-merge check that rejects team documents in deliverables/ or reports/ whose first line is not 'Owner: docs-team'; because agenium.toml defines no local pre_merge command, the check cannot be run from the worktree and only runs at merge time.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project's deliverables/hello.txt already follows the owner-line convention and can be used as a format reference for new documents.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"domain":"team documents","project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document placed in deliverables/ or reports/ must have exactly 'Owner: docs-team' as its first line, with content on the following lines.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) Use PowerShell Get-Content to read and verify file contents in the docs project on Windows.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project lives in a git worktree per ticket at projects/docs/.agenium/worktrees/<TICKET> on branch agenium/<TICKET>.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When authoring a team document under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, add the required 'Owner: <team>' first line before submitting, or the pre-merge check fails.
